mechs.name: Ironclad-IV
mechs.power: Charge behind your shield and bowl mechs over. Front hits barely hurt mid-charge.

mechs.name: Stiletto-B
mechs.power: Leap up to 30 m and slam down where you aim.

mechs.name: Cataclysm
mechs.power: Brace, then drop three mortar shells on a spot 15 to 120 m away.

mechs.name: Arbiter
mechs.power: Send out two decoy drones that draw enemy fire for 6 s.

mechs.name: Longshot
mechs.power: Charge for a second, then fire a zoomed rail shot that hits hard at any range.
